decision_rule: The early-stage score has incremental return value only if the primary matched sample has positive mean executable-return difference on more than half of dates, non-worse mean adverse excursion, sufficient sample size and acceptable post-match balance. Lower-tail and risk improvements are retained separately when the return criterion fails.
limitations: This is a prospective daily-publication cohort accumulated by manual runs. Matching controls observed forecast rank, historical volatility, liquidity, date and market segment, but cannot remove unobserved confounding. Daily high and low data do not establish intraday event order or actual fills. Matching and treatment definitions are frozen before outcomes mature. No model, live report pointer or scheduler is changed.
